title: Choose the Microstrategy
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Choose the microstrategy that best fits each of eight teacher situations, by diagnosing the concern first.

learningObjectives: The learner will apply the matching tables by choosing the microstrategy that best fits each of eight teacher situations, correctly choosing at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The six microstrategies and the matching tables in the section "Matching the Strategy to the Person" in Chapter 19.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then read the feedback and the reason
keyQuestions: A teacher says, "I want to see what this looks like in a real class." Which microstrategy?
A late-majority teacher wants data from a classroom in the same building. Which microstrategy?
commonMisconceptions: The same microstrategy works for every teacher
assessmentOpportunities: A teacher says, "I want to see what this looks like in a real class." Which microstrategy?
A late-majority teacher wants data from a classroom in the same building. Which microstrategy?
Does more training solve every concern?

controls.name: 6 choice buttons
controls.description: Choose one of the microstrategies; two tries per situation.

controls.name: Show descriptions
controls.description: Opens a table of the microstrategies and their meanings.

controls.description: On the results screen, page through the missed items.
